Living Large

Shanghai, Night or Day
Walk out our door into the heart of China’s most vibrant city. Shop, explore, and savour – all in a neighbourhood steeped in history and reborn in modernity.

Touch of Tranquillity
A tasteful interior marked by warm materials, a calming palette and natural lighting come together in an urban sanctuary designed to instil a sense of calm.

Our Spaces
Let our elegantly furnished service apartments lend a touch of class to your stay, with all the space and lifestyle amenities to maximise your comfort.

Coming home to Lanson Place Parkside is like returning to a familiar cocoon of comfort, where every facility, room amenity and guest service is designed to maximise your enjoyment. You’ll find our Hosts willing to answer questions big and small or even give you a tour of our residence and the neighbourhood, while a 24-hour gymnasium and a cosy residents’ lounge provide an effortless fit with your daily routines.

At the Crossroads of History and Glamour
Located in the prestigious Huangpu District, Shanghai, Lanson Place Parkside is ideal for guests who seek both tranquillity and convenience.

Discover Shanghai
Experience a different side of Shanghai by foot at the quiet and idyllic Parkside district, featuring many European style villas and buildings from the early 20th century. Venture just a little further and the never-sleeping city of modern Shanghai re-emerges, with all its vibrant energy and dazzling options for shopping, dining and entertainment.

Discover the Neighbourhood
Located in the quiet and upscale neighbourhood of Huangpu District, Shanghai, Lanson Place Parkside is easily connected to other parts of the city with the adjacent Madang Road metro station. Spend a relaxing afternoon exploring the area’s hip cafes and strolling through local boutiques. Find international brands and restaurants at shopping and entertainment hubs like LuOne Shopping mall and Xintiandi.
Walkable History: Roam the historic lanes of the Huangpu District in search of quaint, highly instagrammable sights and al fresco bistros and cafes. Explore vintage shops and charming local bars in a quintessential experience of old Shanghai.
Asia’s Best Shopping: Hop across the road for the massive LuOne shopping mall for everything from high-street fashion to indie boutiques. Hungry for more? Head over to Xintiandi or iapm mall, both easily accessible by car or metro, for some serious international calibre shopping.
Down to Business: Getting to your workplace is a breeze with Shanghai’s most prominent CBDs including Jing’an Temple Commercial Circle, Huaihai Road Commercial Circle, and People’s Square Commercial Circle all accessible in less than 30 minutes’ drive.

Official overview (JSON-LD / property description)
Ascott Huai Hai Road Shanghai is situated in the heart of Huaihai Road, often referred to as the ‘Champs-Élysées of the East’. Occupying a prime location in the city, it is adjacent to Hong Kong Plaza, Xintiandi, K11 and People’s Square, whilst being close to the lush greenery of Yanzhong Square Park. It is also within easy reach of cultural landmarks such as the Site of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China, the Shanghai Grand Theatre and the Shanghai Museum, offering a perfect blend of bustling commerce, ecological leisure and rich cultural heritage. The apartments are a mere 3-minute walk from South Huangpi Road Station on Metro Line 1, with multiple lines providing seamless access across the city, making it easy to reach popular attractions such as Nanjing Road and Jing’an Temple – a truly unrivalled location. As a high-quality serviced apartment, we offer a diverse range of spacious layouts from studios to three-bedroom units, with open-plan spaces suitable for business stays, family holidays and long-term accommodation. Each apartment is fully equipped with kitchen facilities, a separate washer-dryer, a home entertainment system and individually controlled central air conditioning, allowing guests to enjoy the comforts and convenience of home whilst away. The apartments boast comprehensive facilities, including a gym, an indoor heated swimming pool, tennis courts, a terrace restaurant, a residents’ lounge and meeting rooms, catering to fitness, leisure, social gatherings and business needs alike. With our team’s efficient and attentive service, daily high-standard housekeeping, and the convenience of direct access to the shopping centre and dining options just a stone’s throw away, we are committed to creating a warm and welcoming home in the heart of the city for every guest, allowing you to enjoy comfort and convenience amidst the bustling metropolis. Ascott Huai Hai Road Shanghai has implemented the Ascott Cares 9 commitments to hygiene, cleanliness and safe distancing.

Official summary
One of Shanghai’s best-kept shopping destinations is Huai Hai road. While tourists flock to the truly boisterous Nanjing road, Shanghai locals know that the real shopping lies in the opposite direction. It is here, tucked between the bustling commercial centre and the Yan Zhong Guang Chang park, where our serviced residence lies, offering guests a true oasis in the gleaming metropolitan heart of Shanghai. Apartments are designed to be sophisticated and spacious, ideal for single business travellers to families of six. Each apartment comes with a fully equipped kitchenette, a state-of-the-art family entertainment system and central air-conditioning with individually controlled thermostats.

Official apartment hub (Luxury Serviced Apartment Shanghai)
307 exquisitely appointed guest apartments, ranging from Studio executive to Three-Bedroom Premier (Top Floor), offer diverse layouts to accommodate the needs of all business travellers. Each apartment features a fully equipped kitchen, a high-quality home cinema system, and a suite of modern household appliances. Workstations designed for contemporary business travellers' habits are provided, complemented by high-speed wireless internet access. Guests are assured an exceptional and privileged residential experience.

Official location
One of Shanghai’s best-kept shopping destinations is Huai Hai road. While tourists flock to the truly boisterous Nanjing road, Shanghai locals know that the real shopping lies in the opposite direction. But shopping isn't the only advantage of the residence’s locale. Stroll along this picturesque stretch of buildings in a variety of architectural styles – a majority of which exhibit the Art Deco era.

Official overview (JSON-LD / property description)
Ascott Heng Shan Shanghai is located along the tree-lined Heng Shan Road. Situated in an exclusive historical neighbourhood in the heart of Shanghai, it is close to the Huaihai Road shopping area, Xujiahui Commercial Centre, and foreign consulates. Guests can look forward to a myriad of dining, shopping, entertainment, and lifestyle options for a truly enjoyable stay in Shanghai.
Advantageously located just 3 minutes from the Shanghai Library subway station and 1 minute from Hengshan Road station, Ascott Heng Shan Shanghai is truly convenient. Business travellers will find it easy to gain access to the city business and commercial districts in Xuhui District and the banking sector next to The Bund, a picturesque stretch of buildings in a variety of architecture styles, from Eclectic to Art Deco. Leisure travellers will find the apartments conveniently close to tourist hotspots such as the Jingan Temple, a 10-minute drive away, and high-end shopping strip Xintiandi and People’s Square - both a 15-minute drive away.
Meanwhile, the apartment is located in the heart of Shanghai's former French Concession, nestled within a serene, green environment. Despite being adjacent to the city's core business district, it remains tranquil and peaceful.

Most guest rooms feature private outdoor balconies where guests can enjoy lush greenery at their doorstep—like staying inside a private art gallery—offering an immersive experience of the quiet elegance and poetic charm characteristic of Shanghai’s distinctive neighborhoods without ever having to leave. To meet the different needs of the residents, our clubhouse has a swimming pool, fully equipped gym and yoga room.
The residence also contains an on-site business centre to provide our guests with a comfortable and effective work environment to meet their corporate needs. Ascott Heng Shan Shanghai has implemented the Ascott Cares 9 commitments to hygiene, cleanliness and safe distancing.
